full_text:
Article 4 (Payment of Allowances, etc.)
(1) Notwithstanding Article 5 of the Rules on Allowances, etc. for Judges and Court Officials, overseas service allowances, family allowances, educational allowances for children, and housing allowances payable to seconded judges, etc. may be withheld or paid at reduced rates as determined by the Minister of the National Court Administration.
(2) Where seconded judges, etc. receive remuneration or allowances from the relevant international organization, etc. or from an institution other than the Supreme Court, the Minister of the National Court Administration may deduct the amounts so received when paying their remuneration or allowances: Provided, That the Minister may refrain from making a deduction, or deduct only part of such amounts, where deduction is inappropriate in light of the difficulty of the duties during secondment, the total amount of expenses paid, or other relevant circumstances.
